title: Testimony Navigator
changes: Testimony videos are divided into named chapters with plain-language summaries, so an elderly viewer can jump to a part instead of scrubbing.
Navigator built for older viewers: adjustable text size, slower playback, chapter-at-a-time controls, optional captions, and a 'stop at the end of this chapter' mode.
Right-to-left support, with the navigator's own buttons shown in the language the survivor speaks.
All 13 example testimonies chaptered — 54 chapters and 912 sentence-level cues.
Each example worked backwards through the Collection Wizard's questions, with every answer linked to the chapter it came from.
